## Description
Please describe your changes and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature/parser (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] New behavioral rule (YAML addition)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Verification
- [ ] I have run `go test ./...` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `go vet ./...` without errors.
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `gofmt`.
- [ ] (If adding a parser) I have tested it against a live artifact or provided a test fixture.

## Screenshots (if applicable)
If your change affects the HTML dashboard or TUI, please attach a screenshot.
